title: Four-Generation Family Outdoor Portrait, 1940s B&W Snapshot, USA
description: A 1940s black-and-white family photograph featuring four generations outdoors in front of a wooden clapboard house. The group includes a young woman dressed in a sharp 1940s padded-shoulder jacket, an older woman in a patterned dress, an elderly woman seated in a chair, and a toddler standing in front.
